$comment: The note types that cross the wire, and the one place both languages agree on them.
This file exists because the two halves drifted. The client shipped `checklist` and
`link`; the server's push schema still listed four types and its `notes` table still
carried a CHECK for the same four. A device that captured a checklist got a 400 on the
whole push — and since the push runs before the pull in one cycle, that device stopped
sending AND receiving, permanently, on a note it could not delete its way out of (a
Adding a type now takes three edits that fail loudly if you miss one: this list,
NoteType in packages/core/lib/models/note.dart, and the enum in
apps/backend/src/routes/sync.ts. A test in each language compares its own enum against
this file, so the halves cannot drift apart again without a red build.
Storage constrains nothing — the client dropped its CHECK for this reason and 0008
drops the server's. The wire schema is the gate, and it is right here.
